title: Sana Shop
tagline: A Next.js e-commerce store with product filtering, cart flows, payments, blogs, and admin content management.
description:
Sana-Shop is an e-commerce website built using Next.js with TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Mongoose, and supporting libraries. The website provides a shopping experience where users can browse products, filter them, add products to a cart, make payments after logging in, and read shopping-related blog content.

The admin panel allows the admin to manage website content, including products and user accounts through CRUD operations. It also supports order, blog, and order-status management.
